parsed.explanation: Dossier shows no trans-specific crime, no documented arrests under ambiguous Article 331, and police reportedly act when violence is reported. But Article 331 is used to extort perceived gay men, state and private actors harass or extort LGBTQI+ people, public attitudes toward homosexuality are strongly hostile, and gender-identity protections/recognition are absent. No universal facility, custody, border, or healthcare exclusion is documented, so not High Risk. The combination of state-tolerated extortion of LGBTQI+ people, hostile social climate, weak anti-discrimination recourse, and only inferred trans-specific risk places this in Elevated Risk. Thin evidence is not safety, but no organized campaign against trans visitors is shown.
